title: T47 playbooks: agent-core requirement as a range (0.2.4, maintenance)
head: t47-playbooks-024
body:
## What

`playbooks`' `pyproject.toml` pinned its runtime requirement on `agent-core`
to an exact version, `agent-core==0.4.0`. That's now a range with a floor
and a ceiling: `agent-core>=0.4.0,<0.8`. The `[tool.uv.sources]` entry for
this repo's own dev/test env still points at the vendored `agent-core`
0.4.0 wheel, so playbooks' own tests keep running against the floor
version. Version 0.2.3 -> 0.2.4 everywhere it's asserted (`pyproject.toml`;
`uv.lock` via `uv lock --offline`). No code change. New test:
`tests/test_wheel_metadata.py` builds the wheel and asserts its METADATA
`Requires-Dist` for `agent-core` is exactly `agent-core<0.8,>=0.4.0`
(packaging's normalized order), never an `==` pin, and that the wheel
filename carries `0.2.4`.

**Second commit** (`54e6598`): `skills==0.2.1` (playbooks' other runtime
dependency) had the same stale `agent-core==0.4.0` pin one layer down --
this PR's own resolution proof below found it (`uv lock --offline` against
a real agent-core failed over `skills`, not over playbooks' own range).
Decision #222 fixed it at the source, in `skills`, as a post-release:
`skills==0.2.1.post1` (metadata only, `0.2.2` already exists as a later
release so a normal patch bump would sort ahead of it). This commit pins
playbooks to that post-release instead of the unpatched 0.2.1: `skills==0.2.1`
-> `skills==0.2.1.post1` in `pyproject.toml` and `[tool.uv.sources]`; the new
wheel vendored at `vendor/skills-0.2.1.post1-py3-none-any.whl` with
provenance recorded in `vendor/provenance.json` (source commit `65e5781`,
SHA256 `dd25fae1...53871b16`, decision #34); `uv lock --offline`; and a new
test, `test_wheel_pins_skills_post1`, asserting the built wheel's
`Requires-Dist` for skills is exactly `skills==0.2.1.post1`. No other code
change.

## Why

T47 (decisions #207, #210, #221, #222). The stale exact pin made it
impossible to ever declare a playbooks wheel as a dependency of agent-core
once agent-core moved past 0.4.0 -- no version of playbooks could satisfy
an agent-core install at 0.5+, which is the T47 install bug (`uv sync
--offline` had to drop the vendored playbooks wheel because the lock
didn't know about it, seen 2026-09-28, s43 rig-service restart). Decision
#221 (provisional, orchestrator): same stale-pin shape as connectors
(decision #219), same fix -- a floor+ceiling range, cut as a 0.2.4
maintenance release from the 0.2.3 commit (`ee94894`) on a `release/0.2`
branch, no code change so the rig's behavior is unchanged. The same range
is forward-ported to playbooks `main` in its next release.

Decision #222 (orchestrator, provisional): fixing playbooks' own range
wasn't enough -- `skills` 0.2.1, playbooks' pinned dependency, carried the
identical stale pin one layer down and was not vendored in agent-core, so
the full three-wheel resolution (connectors + playbooks + skills, inside
agent-core's own install) still failed. Same source fix, in `skills`
itself, as a metadata-only post-release. This is playbooks-side only (T47
part 1, both commits); agent-core vendoring and declaring all three wheels
is a separate PR.

## Resolution proof

Scratch-only, nothing committed here or in `agent-core`:

- Built playbooks 0.2.4 and connectors 0.5.1 (from
  `worktrees/connectors-t47`, commit `a7124b8`) wheels into
  `/private/tmp/t47-proof2/`.
- Copied `agent-core`'s `origin/main` (version 0.7.28) via `git -C
  repos/agent-core archive origin/main | tar -x -C
  /private/tmp/t47-proof2/agent-core`.
- Added `connectors==0.5.1` and `playbooks==0.2.4` (sources: the two new
  wheels) to that copy's `[project.dependencies]` / `[tool.uv.sources]`.
- `uv lock --offline`: **fails**, over `playbooks` -> `skills`, not over
  `agent-core`/`connectors`:

  ```
  error: No solution found when resolving dependencies
    cause: Because there is no version of skills==0.2.1 and playbooks==0.2.4
           depends on skills==0.2.1, we can conclude that playbooks==0.2.4
           cannot be used. And because only playbooks==0.2.4 is available
           and your project depends on playbooks, we can conclude that
           your project's requirements are unsatisfiable.
  ```

  Isolated checks in the same copy: `connectors==0.5.1` alone resolves
  cleanly (`Resolved 44 packages`) against the real agent-core 0.7.28 --
  the proof this fix's own claim needs. `playbooks==0.2.4` alone fails
  with the identical error above, confirming the failure is entirely about
  `skills` having no offline source in this copy (no registry, no vendor
  path declared for it here) -- not about playbooks' own agent-core range,
  which is satisfiable. Adding a local path source for `skills` too
  doesn't fix it either: `skills`' own wheel metadata pins
  `agent-core==0.4.0`, which then conflicts with this project's own
  version (0.7.28) as a self-referential cycle (`uv`'s hint: "the package
  `skills` depends on the package `agent-core` but the name is shadowed by
  your project") -- same stale-pin pattern as decisions #219/#221, one
  layer deeper, in `skills`.

  This is exactly what decision #222 (second commit, above) fixes: `skills`
  now ships `agent-core>=0.4.0,<0.8` too, as `0.2.1.post1`. The full
  three-wheel resolution inside a real `agent-core` copy is reported in the
  T47 agent-core PR (out of scope for this repo), not re-run here.

## Checks

<!-- swarm:checks -->

```
uv lock --offline -> Resolved 36 packages, Updated playbooks v0.2.3 -> v0.2.4
uv sync --locked --offline -> Installed 29 packages
uv run --no-sync pytest -q -> 74 passed
uv run --no-sync ruff check . -> All checks passed!
uv run --no-sync mypy --strict src -> Success: no issues found in 11 source files
```

`ruff format --check` is not a CI step in this repo (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`
runs `ruff check .` only, no format step).

## Mutation check

- Mutant: revert `agent-core>=0.4.0,<0.8` back to `agent-core==0.4.0` in
  `pyproject.toml`. Killed by
  `tests/test_wheel_metadata.py::test_wheel_declares_agent_core_as_a_range_not_a_pin`
  (built wheel's `Requires-Dist` is `agent-core==0.4.0`, fails the
  `<0.8,>=0.4.0` assertion). Verified red on the pre-fix pyproject
  (`1 failed, 1 passed`).
- Mutant: drop the ceiling, `agent-core>=0.4.0,<0.8` -> `agent-core>=0.4.0`.
  Killed by the same test (`str(specifier) == "<0.8,>=0.4.0"` is an exact
  match, not a substring/contains check, so a missing ceiling fails it
  too).
- Mutant (second commit): revert `skills==0.2.1.post1` back to
  `skills==0.2.1` in `pyproject.toml` (and its `[tool.uv.sources]` path).
  Killed by `tests/test_wheel_metadata.py::test_wheel_pins_skills_post1`
  (built wheel's `Requires-Dist` for skills is `skills==0.2.1`, fails the
  `==0.2.1.post1` exact-match assertion).
